checks.description: Reference foundation declares container apps environment.
Reference foundation declares azure ai search.
Public network access is disabled by default.
ADLS Gen2 uses OAuth-first access and blocks public blobs/shared keys.
Engineering event queue enables duplicate detection and dead lettering.
PostgreSQL password is a secure deployment parameter, not a committed value.
Template outputs preserve the project claim boundary.

service_decisions.azure_container_apps: reference compute environment; application revisions not deployed
service_decisions.adls_gen2: bronze/silver/gold/quarantine target for curated non-patient data products
service_decisions.service_bus: optional engineering events; stable message IDs and idempotent consumers still required
service_decisions.postgres_flexible_server: optional durable application database; private access and Entra auth remain future work
service_decisions.key_vault: RBAC-oriented secret boundary; workload role assignments remain future work
service_decisions.log_analytics: central log target; dashboards, alerts, sampling, and retention review remain future work
service_decisions.data_factory_or_databricks: not justified at current data volume; local incremental pipeline is the default
service_decisions.azure_managed_redis: not provisioned; current Redis boundary remains replaceable

known_blockers: No Azure subscription deployment or what-if run has been completed.
Private endpoints, VNet integration, private DNS, WAF, and egress policy are not implemented.
Container application revisions and managed-identity RBAC assignments are not provisioned.
PostgreSQL Entra-only authentication, backup restore drill, and regional recovery are not proven.
Azure AI Search index creation and frozen shadow retrieval comparison are incomplete.
No measured cloud load, reliability, security, or cost evidence exists.
claim_boundary: This artifact validates a local Azure reference template only. It is not evidence of a successful cloud deployment, security certification, HIPAA compliance, clinical validation, or production healthcare readiness.
